transcript.content: I want to learn Japanese so I can travel more confidently and understand anime without subtitles someday.
Excellent quest. What would a clear first victory look like for your Japanese Adventure?

In a year I want to handle basic travel conversations, read kana comfortably, and understand simple listening practice. My first milestone would be ordering food and asking directions on a short trip. I know hiragana and a few phrases.
You have the first runes on the map. What time, tools, or study resources do you already have available?

I can study 25 minutes most mornings. I have Genki 1, Anki, headphones, and a language exchange app, but I have not found a consistent speaking partner. I like anime clips and practical travel phrases, want to avoid dry grammar-only drills, and I feel nervous speaking out loud.
